mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS id, d.summary_no AS summaryNo, d.patient_id AS patientId, pt.name AS patientName, IFNULL(bed.name, '') AS bedNo, d.medication_id AS medicationId, md.bus_no AS drugCode, md.name AS drugName, md.total_volume AS spec, d.unit_code AS unit, d.quantity AS quantity, d.dispense_quantity AS dispenseQuantity, d.dosage_instruction AS dosageInstruction, d.frequency_code AS frequencyCode, d.lot_number AS lotNumber FROM med_medication_dispense d LEFT JOIN adm_patient pt ON pt.id = d.patient_id AND pt.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN med_medication_definition md ON md.id = d.medication_id AND md.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_encounter_location el ON el.encounter_id = d.encounter_id AND el.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_location bed ON bed.id = el.location_id AND bed.is_deleted = 0 WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.summary_no = #{summaryNo} ORDER BY d.patient_id, d.created_at
